plugins.description: DSH Web GUI sidebar glance card: DeepSeek account balance, peak/off-peak billing countdown and today's spend / tokens / calls, seated right above the account row. Self-contained host half; @linxin666/dsh-usage optional.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-account-glance English | [中文](README.zh.md)


The live card: probed balance, Beijing peak / off-peak clock, and today's ledger.

A three-line glance card for the DSH Web GUI, seated **directly above** the sidebar's bottom-left **account / Settings** row: | Line | Content | | --- | --- | | 1 | DeepSeek **account balance** — probed from `/user/balance` with the host-held API key; hover names the source | | 2 | **Peak / off-peak** billing period, with a live countdown to the next flip and the discount in effect | | 3 | **Today's spend / tokens / calls**, plus a **manual refresh** button that forces one fresh probe | Peak / off-peak follows DeepSeek's official schedule (Beijing time, UTC+8 all year): **peak** is Monday–Friday `09:00–12:00` and `14:00–18:00` at full price, **every other hour** (nights and weekends included) is billed at **50% off**. The countdown switches to seconds for the final minute. ## Install Needs **DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 or newer**. No other plugin, no dependencies, no build step. ```bash git clone https://github.com/faith372/dsh-account-glance.git dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:./dsh-account-glance ``` The Plugins page also accepts the repository URL in its **Add plugin** dialog. Installing by hand: put the source at `\plugins\dsh-account-glance\`, add the package to both `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles`, then link it into `node_modules` (or run `pnpm install`). Do **not** add `account-glance` to `cordis.patch.yml` yourself — the package ships that row. **Upgrading from 1.3.x:** the host half is new, so restart DSH (or toggle this row off and on in the Plugins page) and refresh the page once. ## Turning it on and off Sidebar **Plugins** icon → **Installed** → **dsh-account-glance**: the card switch toggles the whole bundle, the row switch toggles this card. Instant — no restart, no refresh — and turning it off brings dsh-usage's own glance card back. ## Where the numbers come from Both data sources live in this plugin's own host half and are served over loopback-only routes (`api/dsh-account-glance/overview`, `.../refresh`); the API key never reaches the browser. - **Balance** — `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`, with the key resolved from the DSH credential store (pi-ai record → configured env reference → ambient env). No probe value falls back to the `account` Remote (Settings → Account & balance). A route pointed at a reseller is reported as unsupported rather than probed with the official endpoint; a failure keeps the last good number and flags the row. - **Today's usage** — folded from the session event stream into a small per-day ledger at `/account-glance/ledger.json` (atomic write, 180-day retention), keyed by **Beijing date**. - **Cost** is priced for DeepSeek official routes only (the published CNY peak / off-peak table). Other routes — a DashScope-compatible provider, for example — still count tokens and calls, at cost 0, so a mixed ledger never sums two currencies. - `@linxin666/dsh-usage` is **optional**: install it and nothing breaks — this card still reads its own route first, its glance card stays hidden, and its settings and usage pages keep working. Probing is a read-only account query: no prompt, no tokens, no credit. ## Verify ```bash npm test # node test/verify.mjs && node test/host-verify.mjs ``` Both suites run offline. The client suite boots the shipped `lib/client.js` against React / DOM stand-ins: seat and cadence, the probe outranking the account wallet, the fallback identity, the peak clock's boundary cases, the 15-second deadline, the refresh button, the degradation paths, and the dsh-usage fallback. The host suite covers the clock and price book, the ledger, credential resolution and probe shapes, the origin guard, session folding, the route fence, persistence across a restart, and the entry point. ## Known limitations - Hiding dsh-usage's glance card relies on its `data-dsh-plugin="usage"` / `data-dsh-part="foot-card"` attributes; if it renames them, both cards appear (nothing breaks). - The balance belongs to the DeepSeek account the configured key belongs to — swap the key, swap the number. - Cost appears for DeepSeek official routes only; other routes show tokens and calls without an amount. - With dsh-usage installed too, both plugins keep their own ledger (this one buckets days by Beijing date, dsh-usage by host-local date), so the two totals can differ slightly. - The card hides while the sidebar is collapsed to its 56 px rail, matching the shell's own foot area. ## License MIT — except `lib/host/*` and `lib/index.js`, adapted from [`@linxin666/dsh-usage`](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web) v0.4.4 (Apache-2.0). See [`THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) and [`LICENSE-APACHE`](LICENSE-APACHE).

plugins.description: DSH 的持久化共同白板插件：完整白板在左、原生对话在右，人和 AI 持续维护同一份草稿。基于 draft-board。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH-board

[![CI](https://github.com/MYming-yue/dsh-board/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/MYming-yue/dsh-board/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

**在 DSH 对话旁，放一张人和 AI 可以长期共同维护的白板。**

A persistent shared whiteboard beside the native DeepSeek Harness conversation.

DSH-board 是 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的本地插件，基于 [draft-board](https://github.com/MYming-yue/draft-board)。白板保留理解和成果，对话用来提出问题、讨论与纠正：学一个概念、拆解一个产品，或持续打磨一个项目。

当前为 **0.1.5 早期试用版**。插件单独维护宿主集成，白板界面和模型通过 [upstream.json](upstream.json) 固定上游提交构建，不维护两套白板代码。已构建的安装包可以独立安装，无需相邻的 draft-board 仓库；尚未发布到 npm。

## 可以做什么

- 完整白板在左，DSH 原生对话在右；对话可展开／收起，分隔线可拖动调整宽度。
- 保留 Markdown、LaTeX、图片、卡片备注、关系、集合、布局、结构视图、历史和撤销／重做。
- 新开或切换聊天继续同一张白板，直到主动“新建”或“打开”另一份草稿。
- 选中卡片后发消息，AI 知道本条回复所指的对象；不改写用户回复，不自动附上卡片全文。
- AI 通过 `draft_board_read`／`draft_board_apply` 主动维护白板，复用原子批次、版本校验与整轮撤销。
- 在“设置 → DSH-board 白板”管理启用与卡片关联；关闭功能保留草稿。

## 兼容范围

| 项目 | 已验证范围 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH CLI | 0.1.5-rc.1 |
| DSH 组合包 | 0.1.5-rc.2 |
| 宿主 profile | web |
| 实际宿主联调 | Windows、Chrome |
| 构建环境 | Node.js 22+、npm、Git |

布局和消息提交适配依赖 DSH 当前接口，升级宿主后需要重新验证。其他 DSH 版本和操作系统的完整宿主集成尚未确认；欢迎附版本信息反馈。

## 安装试用版

先确保 DSH web profile 可以正常启动。到 [Releases](https://github.com/MYming-yue/dsh-board/releases) 下载 `dsh-board-0.1.5.tgz`；安装已构建的包不需要 Git、编译工具或 draft-board 源码。

以下为 PowerShell 示例，使用 GitHub CLI 下载。也可以在浏览器下载，再将最后一行改为安装包的绝对路径。

```powershell
$dshHomePath = if ($env:DSH_HOME) { $env:DSH_HOME } else { Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.dsh' }
$pluginDir = Join-Path $dshHomePath 'local-plugins'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $pluginDir | Out-Null
gh release download v0.1.5 --repo MYming-yue/dsh-board --pattern 'dsh-board-0.1.5.tgz' --dir $pluginDir
dsh plugin --profile web add ("file:" + (Join-Path $pluginDir 'dsh-board-0.1.5.tgz'))
```

安装后重启 DSH Web Host，并重新载入页面。在设置中找到“DSH-board 白板”，确认共同白板已启用。

DSH home 使用 `DSH_HOME`，未设置时默认 `~/.dsh`。不要将插件安装到另一个 profile 或 home。更新同样下载新版本安装包后执行 `add` 并重启；构建包使用不同版本和文件名，避免本地依赖缓存误用旧包。

## 第一次体验

1. 在白板上双击创建一张卡片。
2. 选中它，在右侧发送“给这张卡片补充解释”。
3. 观察 AI 工具记录与画布更新，点击“撤销最新一轮”回退该批次。
4. 新开聊天，确认仍然是当前白板。

AI 使用 DSH 原有模型、工具和审批流程。插件不增加模型 API 配置，不管理账户，也不添加云同步。

## 保存、上下文与管理

草稿位于 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-board/`，包含图片与历史；`current.json` 指向当前草稿。主动更换时保留前一份宿主文件。原生“打开”“保存”“另存为”继续可用：宿主持有一份副本，绑定的磁盘原文件仍通过白板保存入口回写，页面刷新后需重新绑定其文件句柄。

固定使用说明注册在系统提示末尾；卡片身份和短标题在本轮运行上下文末尾注入。相同关联复用原生快照，不为每条回复重复追加。不附上全文、时间戳或修订号，不重写既有历史；发生过变化的快照仍由宿主保留，缓存命中率取决于宿主和模型服务。

“设置 → DSH-board 白板”提供“启用共同白板”和“发送时关联选中的卡片”。关闭白板恢复完整聊天区、暂停白板工具，保留草稿与未提交输入；重新启用后继续维护。选项和待处理关联保存在 `plugin-state.json`。

浏览器约每 750ms 与宿主同步。输入、指针操作、布局和回放期间保留当前操作。并行修改冲突时保留双方内容、暂停镜像；另存为后重新打开副本，明确选择继续维护的版本。当前没有自动合并、多任务白板管理、多人协作、AI 图片解析或完整消息／批次追溯。

卸载插件：

```text
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-board
```

随后重启宿主；卸载不会删除 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-board/` 中的草稿。

## 从源码构建

```bash
git clone https://github.com/MYming-yue/dsh-board.git
cd dsh-board
npm ci
node node_modules/playwright-core/cli.js install chromium
npm run check
```

首次构建自动拉取锁定的 draft-board 提交并执行其锁定依赖安装，需要访问 GitHub 与 npm。源码缓存在被忽略的 `.upstream/`；构建产物位于 `lib/`。上游锁不变时复用缓存；更新需显式修改 `upstream.json` 并重新验证。构建不会读取个人 DSH 配置、模型凭据或草稿。

`npm run check` 执行上游类型检查、界面与模型构建、插件测试，以及真实浏览器的安装包检查。安装包检查从 tgz 解压运行，验证持久化、画布接收批次与整轮撤销，不调用模型 API。`DSH_BOARD_BROWSER=chromium` 可指定 Playwright Chromium；默认依次尝试系统 Chrome、Edge、Chromium。Linux 可用 `install --with-deps chromium`。

发布包：

```bash
npm run build
npm pack --pack-destination artifacts
```

贡献前阅读 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) 和 [规格](docs/spec.md)。涉及宿主接口的变化仍需在实际 DSH 中联调，不能只用合成宿主检查宣称兼容。

## 来源与许可

本项目采用 [MIT License](LICENSE)。插件最初位于 draft-board 的 `plugins/dsh-board/`，从提交 `c37c6fe` 拆出。

白板界面和纯模型来自锁定的 draft-board，安装包保留其许可证及来源。构建会收集所嵌入运行依赖的许可证，写入 `lib/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt`；包含 React、KaTeX、markdown-it、fflate、nanoid 等依赖的声明。DSH 本体由使用者单独安装，本插件不打包分发 DSH 源码。

plugins.description: 面向 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的专家与专家团插件：给 AI 加"角色与团队"两个协作维度——用一个领域专家的身份干活，或拉起一支多 Agent 团队按流程交付。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH 专家工坊 · dsh-expert-suite

面向 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的**专家**与**专家团**插件：给 AI 加"角色与团队"两个协作维度——用一个领域专家的身份干活，或拉起一支多 Agent 团队按流程交付。 - **专家（Expert）**：单角色切换——「人设 + 方法论 + 工具白名单」，让 AI 以特定领域专家身份执行任务，且白名单是进程内强约束； - **专家团（Expert Team）**：多 Agent 协作——团长把任务拆解、按需派工给成员子代理、整合交付，支持会话式（和团长对话）与批量（一次跑完）两种工作方式； - **三种创建方式**：手动创建（工具 / 面板表单）、文件导入（JSON / Markdown）、AI 生成（一句话描述 → 自动成稿入库）。 随包内置 8 位专家与 1 个「全栈交付团」，开箱即用。 ## 特性 - 🧑‍💻 **召唤专家**：注入 persona + 工具白名单门禁，`/expert data_analyst` 即用； - 👥 **会话式专家团**：进入团队和团长对话，打招呼就只是打招呼，有任务才按需派工； - ⚙️ **批量交付**：`team_run` 一次跑完整条流水线（serial / parallel / auto 三种执行模式 + step 干预）； - 📥 **多种创建方式**：手动表单 / 文件导入（JSON、Markdown）/ AI 生成，均校验后入库； - 🔒 **进程内权限隔离**：工具白名单由宿主 `tools.guard()` 单调拒绝，不是提示词提醒； - 🎛️ **图形面板**：设置页分栏 + 悬浮入口，浏览 / 创建 / 导入 / 详情 / 一键召唤与进入； - 🧩 **运行时 skill**：每位专家 / 每个团队 / 使用说明都注册为 skill，AI 可随时加载； - 🔌 **零侵入降级**：所有宿主接缝集中在适配层，服务缺席只降级、不影响宿主。 ## 安装 **从 npm 安装（推荐）**：在 DSH 的「插件」页（设置 / 侧边栏）搜索安装 `dsh-expert-suite`；或用命令行： ```sh dsh plugin add dsh-expert-suite ``` 装完**重启一次**：插件加载时会把「专家模式」「专家团模式」两个预设铺到 `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/`，重启后出现在预设选择器里。 **从源码开发安装**：构建产物后引入（见下文「开发」）。 > 兼容性：对齐 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 运行时与 `@deepseek-ai/*` rc peer；更早版本请按宿主安装时的 peer 提示处理（`dsh plugin --profile allow-version` 授权）。 ## 快速上手 ```text # 单专家 /expert-list # 浏览名册 /expert data_analyst # 召唤数据分析师（注入 persona + 工具白名单） /expert data_analyst 帮我解读这份报表 # 召唤 + 立即发送第一句话 /expert-dismiss # 退出专家模式 # 专家团（会话式：进入团队，和团长对话） /team-list # 浏览团队 /team fullstack_delivery # 进入团队（打招呼、问能力、下任务都行） /team fullstack_delivery 你好 # 进入团队并发送第一句话 # 之后正常对话：团长确认任务后才按需派工，打招呼就只是打招呼 # AI 创建（在会话里直接说） 请调用 expert_generate：我需要一个专门写技术文档的专家 请调用 team_generate：帮我组建一个能完成产品从设计到上线的团队 ``` 也可以全程用工具驱动：`expert_list` → `expert_summon` → `expert_dismiss`；团队侧 `team_dispatch`（团长按需派工）/ `team_status` / `team_end`，或 `team_run`（批量一次跑完）。 图形界面：**设置 →「DSH 专家工坊」**（或右下角悬浮按钮）打开浏览面板，可视化浏览 / 创建 / 导入专家与专家团。 ## 核心概念 ### 专家（Expert） 一个专家 = 一份「人设 + 方法论（persona）」+ 一个工具白名单（`toolFilter`）。召唤后，模型以该专家身份执行任务；白名单外的工具调用被当场拒绝（进程内强约束）。字段： `id / name / category / description / capabilities / expertise[] / exampleTasks[] / persona / model? / toolFilter[] / source` ### 专家团（Expert Team） 一个团队 = 团长（lead）+ 若干成员（members），成员按 `order` 排序、各带 `responsibility`。字段： `id / name / description / executionMode(serial|parallel|auto) / interventionMode(auto|step) / members[{expertId, order, responsibility}] / leadPersona? / source` ### 三种创建方式 | 方式 | 入口 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | 手动创建 | 面板「创建专家 / 创建专家团」、工具 `expert_create` / `team_create` | 逐字段填写；团队成员可选现有专家或「自定义角色」现场定义 | | 文件导入 | 面板「导入」、工具 `expert_import` / `team_import` | 专家支持 JSON / Markdown；团队只支持 JSON | | AI 生成 | 面板「AI 生成」、工具 `expert_generate` / `team_generate` | 自然语言描述 → 生成器子代理成稿 → 校验后入库 | ## 使用指南 ### 召唤与退出专家 - 召唤：`/expert `，或面板点「召唤专家」；可带一句话 `/expert 消息` 立即开工。 - 退出：`/expert-dismiss`，或状态条上的 ✕。 - 召唤成功后面板自动收起，右上角状态条显示当前专家 / 团队，可一键退出。 ### 团队协作：会话式（默认）与批量（显式） **会话式（默认）**——`/team <团队id>` 或面板「进入专家团」：注入团长契约，你和团长对话。打招呼、问团队能力就只是对话；有实际任务时团长先澄清目标、再用 `team_dispatch` 按需派工给成员（每次派工 = 一次 one-shot 子代理，等待交付后整合回复你），**不会一上来跑全队**。随时 `team_status` 看派工记录，`team_end` 结束并把各成员交付留档供总结。 **批量（显式）**——`team_run` 工具：给定自包含总目标，团长一次拆解、按执行模式跑完所有相关成员并整合总结。适合"现在就把整件事跑完"。 批量模式的执行模式（团队定义里的 `executionMode`）： - `serial`：按 `order` 串行，后续成员能看到前序交付物； - `parallel`：全部成员同一波次并行（受 `maxParallelMembers` 限制，默认 4），团长最后整合； - `auto`：团长先做结构化规划（`outputSchema` 校验的波次计划），按波次执行；规划失败自动回退为按 `order` 串行并记入日志； - `interventionMode: step`：每位成员（或每个并行波次）交付后暂停，用 `team_message(action=continue)` 放行。 成员的「连续性」由提示词承载（后续派工带上前序交付物全文），子代理会话不做跨派工驻留——这是 v1 的刻意取舍，换取只依赖宿主最稳定的 API 面。 ### 权限与工具白名单 - **专家召唤**：`toolFilter` 通过宿主 `tools.guard()`（单调拒绝，不可撤销）按 agent 生效；白名单外的工具调用被当场拒绝并说明原因。空白名单 = 不限制。 - **团队成员**：每次派工都是一次 one-shot 子代理（`ctx.subagents.start('spawn')`），其 `persona` / `toolFilter` / `maxDepth=1` 在子代理创建窗口内落地，且不能继续向下委派。 - **团长**：默认 `leadToolFace: 'coordinator'`——只协调不执行（拒绝 `bash`/`pwsh`/`write`/`edit`）；可在 Config 改为 `full`。 - **指定模型**：专家定义里的 `model` 映射到子代理 `agentOptions.model`，需要宿主开启「子代理模型选择」opt-in，否则派工会报错——内置专家默认不指定模型（继承会话路由）。 - **跨平台工具名**：`toolFilter` 里的工具名会按当前部署可见工具自动清洗（例如 Windows 上没有 `bash`、提供 `pwsh`），避免未知名导致 spawn 失败。 ## 工具清单（19 个） | 工具 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | `expert_list` / `expert_get` | 列出（支持 `category` 筛选）/ 获取专家完整定义 | | `expert_create` / `expert_import` / `expert_delete` | 创建（zod 校验）/ 导入 / 删除（内置不可删） | | `expert_summon` / `expert_dismiss` | 召唤（注入 persona + 启用门禁）/ 退出 | | `team_list` / `team_get` / `team_create` / `team_import` / `team_delete` | 团队同名管理操作 | | `team_dispatch` | （团长模式）按需派工一项子任务给成员，等待交付并返回 | | `team_run` | 批量模式：`teamId` + 自包含 `objective` 一次跑完全队并整合，返回 `runId` | | `team_status` | 查看运行状态（成员进度、日志、总结）；缺省返回当前会话的活跃团队 | | `team_message` | `action=send` 与成员对话；`action=continue` 放行 step 模式暂停点 | | `team_end` | 结束团队（缺省结束当前会话的活跃团队），返回各成员交付供总结 | | `expert_generate` / `team_generate` | 自然语言 → AI 生成专家 / 从现有名册组团并入库（`save=false` 可只预览） | ## 数据与存储 ``` $DSH_HOME/expert-suite/ ├── experts/.json 用户创建 / 导入 / AI 生成的专家 └── teams/.json 用户创建 / 导入 / AI 生成的专家团 ``` 内置资产随包提供；**同 id 时用户目录版本优先**。内置定义不可删除（返回 `BUILTIN_READONLY`）。 ## 导入格式 ### 专家 **JSON**：直接是完整定义对象；**Markdown**：YAML frontmatter + 正文（正文即 persona）： ```markdown --- id: tech_doc_writer name: 技术文档专家 category: 写作 description: 面向开发者的技术文档写作 expertise: [技术写作, Vue, Vite] exampleTasks: - 把这份源码注释整理成教程 toolFilter: [read, write, grep, glob] capabilities: |- 多行能力介绍…… --- 你是资深技术文档工程师……（persona 正文） ``` ### 专家团 只支持 **JSON**。成员通过 `expertId` 引用**已存在的专家**，所以先确保这些专家在名册里： ```json { "id": "launch_team", "name": "上线筹备组", "description": "把新产品从定义推到上线", "executionMode": "auto", "interventionMode": "auto", "members": [ { "expertId": "product_manager", "order": 0, "responsibility": "产出需求定义与验收标准，交给设计师" }, { "expertId": "ui_designer", "order": 1, "responsibility": "基于需求产出界面方案" }, { "expertId": "code_reviewer", "order": 2, "responsibility": "评审可实现性与风险" } ], "leadPersona": "可选：自定义团长人设，留空用内置模板" } ``` - `executionMode`：`auto`（推荐）/ `serial` / `parallel`； - `interventionMode`：`auto` 全自动 / `step` 每位成员交付后暂停等你放行； - `members[].order`：数字，决定默认执行顺序；`members[].responsibility`：该成员负责什么、产出交给谁； - 名册里没有的角色，可在「创建专家团」表单用「+ 自定义角色」现场建，或先创建 / 导入专家；导入后自动注册运行时 skill，同 id 覆盖已有版本。 ## 插件配置 在 `cordis.yml` 的插件行里配置： ```yaml - insert: - id: expert-suite name: 'dsh-expert-suite' config: dataDir: '' # 缺省 $DSH_HOME/expert-suite layPresets: true # 自动铺设两个预设 maxParallelMembers: 4 # 波次内最大并行子代理数 leadToolFace: 'coordinator' # coordinator | full ``` ## 架构与平台集成 宿主半边按官方契约实现：`ctx.tools.register` / `ctx.tools.guard`、`ctx.subagents.start('spawn', …)`、`ctx.skills.register`（运行时 skill）、`ctx.commands.register`、`ctx.webServer.register`（0.2.0 起为 `webServer`，0.1.5 线为 `httpServer`，两个名字都挂 inject 回调、谁先就绪注册谁）、`agent.inject` / `agent.followup`、`ctx.agents.get` / `list`。所有宿主接缝集中在 `src/ports.ts`（host）与 `src/client/slots.ts`（client），改宿主版本适配只动这两处。 Client 半边按官方模块加载契约实现（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 自注册、`require('react')` 取平台 React、导出 `{ apply, inject }`），面板是 Vue 3 SFC 通过 React 宿主组件以「孤岛」挂载。入口为两个已核实的官方 slot：`settings.section`（设置页分栏）与 `shell.overlay`（右下角悬浮按钮）。面板数据与动作走 `/expert-suite/*` 路由（在 webserver 上注册；无 webserver 的 profile 自动降级为只读空态）。 两个值得知道的平台行为： - **链接安装的包**（`link:` / `file:`）内部 import 的 `@deepseek-ai/*` peer 会被宿主重定向到安装副本——本包 `peerDependencies` 必须与运行时真实 import 一一对应； - **插件展示元数据**：`locale/{en,zh}.json` 的 `meta.title/description` + `package.json` 的 `icon`（宿主 `readPluginMeta` 经 ESM 解析读取，`exports` 必须放出 `./locale/*.json`）。 ## 开发 ```sh pnpm install pnpm run typecheck # TypeScript 严格模式（零错误为合并门禁） pnpm run build # host（tsc → dist/）+ client（vite → dist/client.js） pnpm publish # 发布前会先跑 build ``` 本地装进 DSH 调试：把本包以 `link:` / `file:` 引入 profile，或 `

plugins.description: dsh plugin: read-only host diagnostics (log tail, service-face reachability, crash attribution) plus a key-gated session mouth, closed by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-backroom

A read-only **back room** for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) plugin authors: it makes the host's own log buffer readable over loopback HTTP, and reports — live, in the running process — which official service faces a plugin can actually reach.

`dsh-backroom` is a community plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/). Not an official DeepSeek AI product.

## Why this plugin exists

Two things were missing on the installed desktop host (0.2.0-rc.2), and neither is an API gap:

- **Nobody reads the host's log buffer.** `ctx.logger`'s only built-in sink is cordis' in-memory ring (`logger.buffer`, 1000 entries), and the shipped product registers a second exporter only for the fatal-startup path. Host code logs through `logger`, not `console` (`dsh-hmr` alone emits 19 logger calls), and in the packaged app the backend child's stdout is piped into a GUI process and lost. So "the plugin mounted but did nothing" had no evidence at all.
- **Reachability was measured once and recorded wrong.** Whether `ctx.get('sessionController')` works from a plugin fiber is decided in the running process, not in a `.d.ts` file. This plugin answers that with a live matrix instead of a guess.

## What it does

Current build is the **probe + fault-attribution + narrow session mouth** shape: host half only, four loopback routes, no UI, and no disk writes from the plugin.

| Route | Returns |
|---|---|
| `GET /dsh-backroom/probe` | Per-service matrix: for each name, `ctx.get(name, true)` / `ctx.get(name, false)` reported separately as `present(<type>)` / `absent` / `threw: <message>`, plus the face's own method names; property-access results for declared vs undeclared deps; `hmr.getLinked()` as-is; how many log records were already buffered before this plugin applied (that is the replayability reading); node/argv/`DSH_*` env **names**; `ctx.fiber.state`. |
| `GET /dsh-backroom/logs?limit=&level=&contains=` | The log tail: everything `ctx.logger` produced since apply **plus** plugin `console.error/warn` output. `level` accepts `error|info|warn|debug` or the official numeric levels 0..3. Ring cap 4000 lines, with the dropped count reported. |
| `GET /dsh-backroom/faults?limit=&dir=` | **Crash attribution**: reads the desktop crash sinks (`%APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\logs\crash-*-host.log` / `-renderer.log`) and per file returns the first *installed-bundle* frame (the suspect), the first official frame (the face it mis-called), the `dsh: fatal …` cause line and the wrapper line **as two separate fields**. Files with no installed-bundle frame come back with a reason instead of a guess (`renderer-crash` / `no-stack` / `no-installed-bundle-frame`). Default root is the desktop tree; a CLI instance points it with `DSH_BACKROOM_CRASH_LOGS=<dir>`. `dir` must sit inside an allowed root — this route is cookie-free, so it must not become a local file-read oracle; anything else gets **403**. |

| `GET`/`POST /dsh-backroom/session?session=&key=` | **The narrow session mouth (closed by default)**: `GET` reads one allow-listed session's turn face from the projections that are *actually in the public bag* (`turnOutline`, an array of `{turn,seq,prompt,response}`, and `sessionStats.turns`) and returns `turnCount/lastTurn/lastResponseChars/asOfSeq/readable`; `POST` sends one prompt into that **already-registered** session, and `&wait=turn-end&timeoutMs=…` waits until a new turn appears **and** its `response` has been filled by `turn/end`, returning `ended/endedClaim/turnStarted/assistantResponded/waitedMs`. Only the official handlers are used — `sessionController.prompt(request, signal)` / `.projections(request, signal)`, **both arguments required**. Measured end-to-end on the packaged desktop 10-09: one prompt took `turnCount 1→2`, `asOfSeq 19→30`, and the durable log holds exactly two `turn/end reason:"completed"` with two replies. When the criterion cannot be read the route self-reports `endedClaim:"unreadable"` instead of calling it "not finished". (The earlier wording — read `turnBoundary.lastTurn` — was a guess; that unit is not in the public bag. See `docs/PLUGIN-RULES.md` §H.5.) |

All four routes are registered on the plugin's own path prefix through `webServer.register()`, so they answer without the app's session cookie (like `/dsh-chamber/*`). `Cache-Control: no-store`. **The first three are read-only**; the fourth spends your model quota, which is why it is gated behind two environment variables and refuses to create sessions. No route writes to disk; the only disk write in this package is the CLI below, and it writes only after taking a byte-for-byte backup outside the repository.

### What "narrow mouth" means (plain words, no jargon)

**It is a door that is locked unless you start dsh with a key.** The first three routes only look; the fourth one can put a message into one of your conversations, which touches your data and spends your quota. So it does not "start open and behave yourself" — with no key set it answers `403 disabled` and is effectively absent:

1. no `DSH_BACKROOM_SESSION_KEY` in the environment when dsh starts ⇒ every call is refused;
2. the session must appear in `DSH_BACKROOM_SESSION_ALLOW` ⇒ it never picks "the most recent session" for you and **never creates a session**;
3. even then: 6 prompts/minute, text ≤ 4000 chars, body ≤ 16 KB, a wait capped at 120 s.

"Narrow" = it can only send text into a session you named, and read whether that turn finished. It cannot switch models, cancel, edit queues, or mint a token — and the test suite fails the build if a second call site or a `create` appears.

Daily use, safety first and little friction:

```powershell
# normal day: just start dsh from its icon. The door is closed; the three read-only routes work.
# when you do want to send one:
powershell -File tools\start-desktop-with-mouth.ps1 -Sid <your session id>
#  -> it mints a one-run key and prints it (never stored on disk, gone when the app exits),
#     stops the running instance, restarts it with that env, waits for port 19387,
#     and prints the exact curl line to paste.
```

Why not keep the key in your user environment variables: that copy is plaintext, readable by any local process and by roaming/profile backups. Not persisting it buys *default-closed* plus *no stored secret* — it is a smaller exposure surface, not absolute security (a process that can read your env can already read your cookies).

### How a model inside dsh uses it (the agent tool surface)

The read-only routes need no cookie, but **a model in a session does not know that port exists** — without a tool surface only a prompt that was told about it can use it. So the read-only capabilities are additionally registered as official `defineTool` tools (taken via `ctx.get('tools', false)`; if that service is absent the plugin reports `absent` and still mounts instead of hard-depending on it):

| Tool | What it does | Gate |
|---|---|---|
| `backroom_probe` | host shape: reachability matrix plus this plugin's own counters, including the session mouth's refusal ledger | none, read-only |
| `backroom_logs` | host log tail (`limit/level/contains`) | none, read-only |
| `backroom_faults` | crash-log attribution (`limit/dir`) | none, read-only |
| `backroom_workspace` | `list` the profile's workspaces, or `create` one through the official `workspaceController.create` (an existing path comes back `created:false`) | **yes**: `DSH_BACKROOM_WORKSPACE_ROOTS` (prefix list); unset ⇒ `disabled` |
| `backroom_wsl_workspace` | `distros`/`ls`/`check` via `dsh-wsl-workspace`'s own loopback bridge; `create` composes in the order that plugin's client uses (official create, then its `registerWindows`/`setUser`) | `create`: `DSH_BACKROOM_WSL_DISTROS`; the three reads need nothing |
| — | **the `session` route is deliberately not a tool** | safety first: no session gets a button that spends your quota |

Two design notes: ① the WSL path **does not copy another plugin's private state** — `~/.dsh/wsl-workspaces.json` belongs to `dsh-wsl-workspace`, and we only delegate in its own call order; if the official create fails, registration is never attempted (no half-done workspace), and

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-bulwark

DSH 插件：向 systemPrompt 注入守则段，并在工具调用层拦截受保护路径的修改与受保护插件的卸载。

## 功能

- **守则注入**：把一个可配置的守则段写进 systemPrompt，位置由中心顺序表推导。
- **路径保护**：拦截对 protectedPaths 内路径的写 / 删 / 移动（含相对路径与 cd 链解析、重定向、dd / truncate / tee、python / node 内联脚本）。
- **插件卸载保护**：命中 protectedRemovalPatterns 关键词的卸载 / 删除命令一律拦截。
- **配置热重载**：监听 config.json，改动后无需重启。
- **逃生通道**：一个环境变量即可完全禁用。

## 安装

```
dsh plugin add github:Hashing2030/dsh-bulwark
```

安装后重启 DSH 生效。

> **首次启动会看到一行提示**：
> `[dsh-bulwark:config] watcher unavailable, config changes need a restart: ENOENT...`
> 这不是错误。它表示 config.json 还没创建，热重载暂未启用。创建配置文件后此提示自动消失。

## 配置

配置文件路径：`$DSH_HOME/dsh-bulwark/config.json`（`DSH_HOME` 未设置时退回 `~/.dsh`）。

完整默认值：

```json
{
  "rulesText": "[dsh-bulwark 守则] 部分工具和路径受保护，不要尝试绕过。",
  "protectedPaths": [],
  "protectedRemovalPatterns": [
    { "keywords": ["dsh plugin", "remove", "dsh-bulwark"] },
    { "keywords": ["dsh plugin", "remove", "dsh-plugin-host-template"] },
    { "keywords": ["dsh plugin", "remove", "dsh-plugin-client-template"] },
    { "keywords": ["pnpm", "remove", "dsh-bulwark"] },
    { "keywords": ["npm", "uninstall", "dsh-bulwark"] }
  ]
}
```

字段说明见 [CONFIG.md](CONFIG.md)。

## 用 CLI 管理配置（推荐）

不建议手改 JSON。用 scripts/protect.sh：

```
# 从插件安装目录进入（路径按实际 profile 替换）
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-bulwark

./scripts/protect.sh add /path/to/protect
./scripts/protect.sh list
./scripts/protect.sh remove /path/to/protect
./scripts/protect.sh test "rm -rf /path/to/protect/foo"
./scripts/protect.sh set-rules "[dsh-bulwark 守则] 新的守则内容"
```

也可以克隆一份仓库，用仓库里的脚本操作同一个配置文件：

```
git clone https://github.com/Hashing2030/dsh-bulwark
cd dsh-bulwark
./scripts/protect.sh add /path/to/protect
```

完整命令说明见 [SCRIPT-USAGE.md](SCRIPT-USAGE.md)。

## 逃生通道

```
DSH_FORTRESS_DISABLE=1 dsh web
```

设置这个环境变量后，DSH 启动时完全不加载 dsh-bulwark。清除即恢复。

> 变量名 DSH_FORTRESS_DISABLE 中的 FORTRESS 是项目旧名（dsh-fortress）的遗留。改名时保留它是为了不破坏已有配置。

## 本地开发

```
pnpm install
pnpm build          # tsdown → dist/index.js
dsh web --patch cordis.yml    # 用源码路径加载，不用装
```

## 测试

```
pnpm test:e2e       # 71 条端到端回归
```

## 相关文档

- [配置说明](CONFIG.md)
- [脚本用法](SCRIPT-USAGE.md)
- [灾难恢复](DISASTER-RECOVERY.md)
- [测试说明](TESTING.md)
- [迁移记录](MIGRATION.md)

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-task-splitter

**A DSH host plugin that notices long tasks and splits them before they fail — built for small-context local models.**

[中文说明见下方](#中文说明)

Small local models (llama.cpp / Ollama, e.g. Qwen3 27B at IQ2 with `maxTokens: 8192`) fail long tasks in two
*completely different* ways. This plugin detects both on the **host side** and hands the model an executable
procedure, instead of hoping the model judges its own limits.

| | **Lane A — long output** | **Lane B — long workflow** |
|---|---|---|
| Example | "write a 3000-word industry report, 4 sections" | **"pick me a stock likely to rise tomorrow"** |
| Prompt shape | usually explicit | **often tiny** ("pick me a…") |
| Real bottleneck | the per-request output budget (`maxTokens`) | **step count and context**: tool output floods the window, a small model drifts, intermediate results get lost |
| What this plugin does | scaffolds `tasks/<slug>/parts/NN-*.md` + `MANIFEST.json`; one part per reply, then `assemble` | scaffolds `tasks/<slug>/PLAN.md` + `notes/`; **plan first, one step per reply, results on disk** |

## How it decides

Scoring runs in the host (no model cooperation needed):

- **Lane A signals** — explicit word/char count, explicit part count, numbered section list (used as part titles),
  long-document keywords + a writing verb, very long prompt, multi-deliverable phrasing.
- **Lane B signals** — decision/research verbs (pick / recommend / evaluate / compare / analyse / predict / research / screen)
  **plus** a data-dependent domain noun (stocks, funds, housing, flights, insurance, papers, competitors, laptop…),
  explicit multi-step phrasing, or "needs current external data".
- Single-lookup requests ("what's the weather tomorrow") are deliberately clamped below the threshold.

Examples:

| Prompt | Result |
|---|---|
| `what's the weather` | no split |
| `look up tomorrow's weather for me` | no split (single lookup) |
| `recommend me a movie` | no split (score 2 < 3) |
| **`pick me a stock likely to rise tomorrow`** | **Lane B** → `PLAN.md` + `notes/`, "plan first, one step per reply" |
| `compare these three laptops and pick one` | **Lane B** |
| `write a 3000-word industry report, 4 parts` | **Lane A** → 4-part skeleton |
| a prompt with a 1./2./3. section list | **Lane A** (part titles taken from the list) |

The procedure is injected with `agent/pre-step` **prepended to the very same request** (no extra round trip),
and only for steps that start from a human message.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-task-splitter
```

Restart DSH afterwards. To build from source: `npm pack` then
`dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add file:./dsh-task-splitter-0.1.0.tgz`.

Requires a DSH host that exposes `agent/pre-step`, `ctx.agents` and `ctx.sessions`
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent` / `dsh-session` `^0.1.1-rc.2 || ^0.2.0-rc.1`).

## Configuration

```yaml
# in your profile cordis patch (or a home patch)
- id: task-splitter
  config:
    enabled: true
    providers: [qwen-local]   # empty array = every provider
    lanes: [parts, plan]      # drop one to disable that lane
    minScore: 3               # Lane A threshold
    workflowScore: 3          # Lane B threshold (raise to 4 to be more conservative)
    maxParts: 8               # Lane A: at most this many parts
    wordsPerPart: 900         # Lane A: target chars per part
    tasksDir: tasks           # relative to the session working directory
    toolPath: ''              # CLI used in the injected rules; defaults to the bundled one
```

## Bundled CLI

`dsh-task-parts` (also exported as `dsh-task-splitter/task-parts`) drives Lane A outside the model:

```bash
node bin/task-parts.mjs init <taskDir> --title "T" --parts "one|two|three"
node bin/task-parts.mjs status <taskDir>     # ✅/⬜ per part, exits 2 while incomplete
node bin/task-parts.mjs next <taskDir>       # the next part to write
node bin/task-parts.mjs assemble <taskDir>   # concatenates into final.md
```

## Limitations (please read)

- Lane B guarantees **process and honesty** (plan, evidence on disk, sources, uncertainty, "do not fabricate data"),
  **not** the correctness of the answer. A local model with no market/financial data source cannot honestly predict
  tomorrow's stock move — the procedure makes it say so instead of inventing numbers.
- Detection is heuristic. `workflowScore` / `minScore` are the knobs; the plugin never blocks a turn — worst case it
  adds one short instruction message.
- Tested against a Windows DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 host with llama.cpp-served Qwen3; 27 offline simulation cases ship in
  [`test-sim.mjs`](./test-sim.mjs) (not included in the npm tarball).

## License

MIT

---

## 中文说明

**DSH 宿主插件：在长任务失败之前识别它并拆开 —— 为小上下文本地模型而做。**

本地小模型（llama.cpp / Ollama，例如 `maxTokens: 8192` 的 Qwen3-27B IQ2）会在**两类完全不同的**长任务上翻车，
本插件在**宿主侧**把两类都识别出来，并交给模型一套可执行的规程，而不是指望模型自己判断极限。

| | **车道 A：产出型** | **车道 B：流程型** |
|---|---|---|
| 例子 | "写一篇 3000 字的行业报告，分 4 部分" | **"帮我选一只明天大概率会涨的股票"** |
| 提示词 | 通常明确 | **可能极短** |
| 真正瓶颈 | 单次输出预算（`maxTokens`） | **步骤数与上下文**：工具结果塞满窗口、小模型多步跑偏、中间结果丢失 |
| 插件动作 | 建 `tasks/<slug>/parts/NN-*.md` + `MANIFEST.json`；每轮只写一段，最后 `assemble` | 建 `tasks/<slug>/PLAN.md` + `notes/`；**先立计划、每轮一步、结果落盘** |

判定在宿主侧打分（不依赖模型自觉）：车道 A 看字数/分段/分节列表/长文关键词/超长提示词；
车道 B 看**决策研究类动词 + 依赖数据的领域名词**、显式多步措辞、是否需要实时外部信息；
单次查询类（"帮我查一下天气"）会被压到阈值以下。

规程通过 `agent/pre-step` **前置到同一次请求**里（不额外耗一轮），且只处理以人类消息开始的那一步。

安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add dsh-task-splitter
```

装完重启 DSH。配置项同上（`lanes` / `minScore` / `workflowScore` / `maxParts` / `wordsPerPart` / `tasksDir` / `toolPath`）。

**局限**：车道 B 保证的是**过程与诚实性**（计划、证据落盘、来源、不确定性、禁止编造数据），**不保证答案正确**；
本地没有行情/财务数据源时，它就该说"给不出可靠结论"，而不是编数字。检测是启发式的，
`workflowScore` / `minScore` 可调；最坏情况只是多注入一条很短的指令，不会阻塞任何一轮。

MIT 许可。

# dsh-session-attention

![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-session-attention)
![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-session-attention)
![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-%3E%3D0.2.0--rc.2-blue)
![compat](https://github.com/Meltllsy/dsh-session-attention/actions/workflows/compat.yml/badge.svg)

DSH **会话注意力提醒**插件 —— 只管「DSH 会话」这一件事：

- **完成 / 提问 / 审批提醒**：agent 完成一轮回复（`turn/end` + `completed`）、用
  `ask_user_question` 提问、或有审批请求（`approval/asked`）时提醒你。三类可分别开关。
- **只在切出 DSH 时弹**：标签页可见时不打扰（你正看着屏幕，不需要提示）；切走时转成
  **系统原生通知** + **提醒音**，点通知回到 DSH。
- **活动悬浮球**：页面右下角可拖动的球，显示 DSH 当前活跃会话（思考中 / 执行工具 / 等待你，
  最多 5 个、按最近更新排序），有活动时发光脉动；点开可跳回对应会话；另有画中画悬浮窗。
- **侧边栏「提醒」入口**：开关、音量、音色、试听、系统通知授权、悬浮球设置。

> 本插件是 `dsh-todo-reminder` 拆出来的**会话模块**。个人待办（全局、与会话无关）留在
> `dsh-todo-reminder`，两者数据、设置、声效文件、接口全部独立，可单独安装、单独卸载。

## 安装

从 npm 装（推荐）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-session-attention    # 桌面端
dsh plugin --profile web     add dsh-session-attention    # 浏览器版
```

从源码装（仓库里已带构建产物 `lib/`，克隆后可直接指过去）：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Meltllsy/dsh-session-attention.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<克隆目录>
```

> 改了源码想重新构建：`npm install && npm run prepack`（host 半 `tsc` → `lib/`，client 半 `tsdown` → `lib/client.js`）。
## 设置与数据

| 项 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| 设置文件 | `$DSH_HOME/session-attention/settings.json`（原子写） |
| 自定义提醒音 | `$DSH_HOME/session-attention/session.{mp3,wav,ogg,m4a}` |
| 旧位置（仍然有效） | `$DSH_HOME/todo-reminder/session.*` |
| HTTP 接口 | `/api/attention/state`、`/api/attention/set-settings`、`/api/attention/events`（SSE）、`/api/attention/sound` |

**一次性迁移**：首次运行时若本模块的设置文件不存在，会从旧插件
`$DSH_HOME/todo-reminder/todos.json` 的 `settings.attention` / `settings.ball`
读一次当种子并立即落盘；旧文件不删，回滚安全。

## 音效怎么走

1. **自定义音效文件优先**：设置面板里点过试听/在页面点过任意位置后，音频解锁并探测
   `/api/attention/sound`，命中则解码为 AudioBuffer 使用。
2. **内置合成音兜底**：没有文件 / 解码失败时用 WebAudio 现场合成（info / success / warning / danger 四套音色）。
3. **系统通知兜底**：音频尚未解锁时，由系统通知自己出声（`silent: false`）。

音频解锁靠 document 上的手势监听自动完成（点 DSH 里任何地方即可），不需要专门操作。
页面内音效在前台/后台都会响；**页面完全关闭时不会响**，那时只有系统通知，而浏览器通知
只能用系统默认音（浏览器 API 不允许指定自定义音）。

## 限制

- 提醒需要 GUI 标签页存在（后台亦可）；页面完全关闭期间不会有任何提醒。
- 活动悬浮球、画中画、侧边栏入口都是 DOM 注入，依赖 DSH shell 的类名；shell 大改版可能需同步更新选择器。

## 构建

```bash
npm install          # 只需一次
npm run prepack      # host 半 tsc → lib/；client 半 tsdown → lib/client.js
```

host 半只依赖 `node:` 内置模块（自包含）；client 半经 tsdown 打包为 ModuleLoader 客户端，React 交给宿主运行时。

## 兼容性

本插件依赖 DSH 的一些**内部点**（服务名、事件名、DOM 类名、客户端包格式）。DSH 演进较快，
这些点在版本之间**会变** —— 插件断掉往往不是插件自己的 bug，而是这里变了。所以仓库里带了一个自检脚本：

```bash
npm run check:compat                        # 检查本机已装的 DSH
node scripts/check-compat.mjs --from <dir>  # 检查指定目录（CI 用）
```

实测结果：

| DSH 版本 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `0.2.0-rc.2`（当前） | ✅ 15/15 |
| `0.2.1-alpha.2`（下一个） | ✅ 15/15 |

依赖点一览（断哪条、坏哪个功能，脚本输出里都写了）：

| 分类 | 依赖点 |
|---|---|
| 客户端 | `__ModuleLoader__` 加载器格式、`/plugins` 资源路由 |
| 服务 | `uiWorkspace.openSession`、会话列表 `byId` 快照、host 的 `webServer` / `systemPrompt` |
| DOM | 类名含 `sessionRow` / `newSession` / `centerCol` |
| 事件 | `session/event` / `turn/end` / `approval/asked` / `tool/call` |
| 工具 | `ask_user_question` |

**GitHub Actions 每周自动跑一次**（含 alpha 版本），不通过就自动开 issue —— 所以 DSH 更新导致的不兼容
会被提前发现，而不是等用户先撞上。

> 与 [dsh-todo-reminder](https://github.com/Meltllsy/dsh-todo-reminder) 是各自独立的插件，互不依赖，可单独安装。

## 截图

plugins.readme_text:
# Analog Liquid Glass for DeepSeek Harness

> **把 DeepSeek Harness 的输入框变成一片模拟质感的液态玻璃。**

顶部镜面高光、内缘白线、边缘溢出的一圈柔光；模型思考时玻璃里往上冒泡；
深浅主题切换带 1.7 秒的从容过渡。

名字里的 **Analog** 指**模拟仪表那种质感**（弯液面、观液管、刻度），不是技术上的"模拟/数字"
—— 对应插件里的玻璃容器、液位式进度与上升的气泡，也与"数字进度条"划清界线。图标即为此意。

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/Siloet-phy/analog-liquid-glass-for-dsh)

![浅色](docs/light.png)
![深色](docs/dark.png)

## 安装

从 GitHub 安装（**当前推荐**，本包尚未发布到 npm）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:Siloet-phy/analog-liquid-glass-for-dsh
```

> 桌面版 DSH 的包管理需要**先完全退出 DSH** 再执行；装完重启生效。
> profile 名一般是 `desktop`（桌面版）或 `web`（`dsh web` 起的服务）。

如果只想用短名（需要在 npm 上已发布同名包）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add analog-liquid-glass-for-dsh
```

## 它做了什么

| 元素 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **磨砂层** | 白雾 + 重度模糊，是"玻璃感"的来源（不是简单叠一层半透明） |
| **顶部镜面高光** | 玻璃最容易辨认的那道柔光 |
| **内缘白线** | 上缘一道发丝白线 |
| **外扩散泛光** | 光从玻璃边缘微微溢到外面一圈 |
| **三点吐泡泡** | **只在模型思考时出现**：三颗泡错开 1/3 周期、同一个出生点，一个破灭、一个新生 |
| **主题过渡** | 浅 ↔ 深切换时，玻璃比整页更慢地插值（1.7s vs 0.9s） |
| **真毛玻璃** | 为做出磨砂感，覆盖原生卡片的背景与 `backdrop-filter`（见下方"设计决定"第 2 条） |

## 两个我坚持的设计决定

1. **玻璃里不放颜色。**
   真正的液态玻璃几乎是"无色"的——透白玻璃 + 染白的雾 + 白边色散。
   颜色只允许出现在**边缘的高光**上。任何"玻璃内部有一团彩色在流动"的做法，
   看着都会像彩色塑料。（我做出过六版彩色玻璃，全被否了。）
2. **玻璃层只往 slot 里"加层"**，靠测量原生卡片的矩形贴合尺寸，不改它的 DOM 结构。
   唯一例外是"真毛玻璃"：为做出磨砂感，会覆盖 `[data-composer-card]` 的背景与
   `backdrop-filter`（这是毛玻璃唯一能成立的物理位置——在卡片内容之上加雾会把文字压淡，
   对它做 `backdrop-filter` 会把文字一起糊掉）。该段集中在 `client.js` 一处、带注释与旋钮，
   删掉即回到纯加层模式；`/` 菜单底板那处小修复同理可删。卸载后不留任何样式。

## 图标

`icon.svg` 的立意是**模拟仪表**，和"数字进度条"划清界线：

一根竖直的**玻璃观液管**（sight tube），里面一柱淡蓝液体，顶端一道**弯液面**
（液体贴管壁上翘的那道弧，是"模拟时代"最一眼可辨的符号），液柱里两点气泡正在上升。
—— 玻璃是容器、液位是进度、气泡是"模型正在思考"，正好对应插件的三件事。

配色与插件本体一致（天蓝 `112,176,244` 为主、冷白为釉）。
多尺寸与深浅底的对照见 [`docs/icon-preview.html`](docs/icon-preview.html)；
设计草图留在 [`docs/icon-concept.svg`](docs/icon-concept.svg)，
上一版图标备份在 [`docs/icon-previous.svg`](docs/icon-previous.svg)。

## 兼容性

- **DSH**：`0.2.0-rc.2` 及以上（依赖 `conversation.input.overlay` slot 与
  `ctx.theme` 的 `theme/change` 事件）。
- **平台**：Web 客户端（桌面版内置浏览器 / `dsh web`）。纯 CLI 会话不受影响。
- **浏览器**：Chromium 系（Electron）。用到 `backdrop-filter` 与 `color-mix()`，需要现代内核。
- **无障碍**：遵循 `prefers-reduced-motion`——开启后所有动画停止，只保留静态玻璃与状态色。

## 开发

```bash
node selftest.mjs                      # 19 项断言：替身环境，验证模块面与 apply() 行为
node livetest.mjs [react-umd 目录]      # 30 项断言：真 React + 真 DOM，验证真的能渲染
```

- **`selftest.mjs`**：用替身把客户端 bundle 完整跑一遍——语法、模块面（`name`/`inject`/`apply`）、
  `apply()` 在有无服务时的行为、slot 注册目标、样式挂载、`theme/change` 订阅、组件渲染。
  **改完 `client.js` 先跑它**，因为客户端 bundle 一旦在最顶层抛错会牵连 Web 端模块系统。
- **`livetest.mjs`**：需要 `react`/`react-dom`/`jsdom`（**故意不进 package.json 依赖**，
  避免让插件包带上开发期重量）。它用**真 React** 把玻璃层真的挂进真 DOM，并验证
  几何锚定（含"包含块非视口"时的差值归零）、fail-closed 行为、
  `running` 状态翻转时 `data-busy` / `data-on` 跟着变、卸载后 DOM 清干净。

> 两个测试装置上的坑（都写进注释了）：
> ① `document`/`window` 必须在 `require('react-dom')` **之前**就位；
> ② 必须用 `createRoot` + `act()`，**不能用 legacy `ReactDOM.render`**——
>    legacy render 会把 passive effects 推到下一个任务，同步断言时会看到
>    "玻璃层没进 DOM"这种**假失败**。

## 技术笔记

- **主题**：直接消费 DSH 的 `--dsw-*` token 与 `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`，
  **不自己管理主题状态**；过渡窗口通过监听 `ctx.theme` 的 `theme/change` 事件实现。
- **挂点**：`conversation.input.overlay`（list，session 作用域）；
  "模型是否在思考"来自标准 props 的 `useSession((s) => s.running)`，
  取不到时退化为观察原生按钮的「发送 ↔ 停止」态（MutationObserver），保证气泡不会静默失效。
- **几何**：玻璃层用 `position:fixed` + 实测原生卡片矩形写进 CSS 变量。
  ⚠ 取的是「卡片矩形 − 自身矩形」的**差值**，不能直接用卡片的视口坐标——
  卡片一旦带 `backdrop-filter` 就会成为 fixed 的包含块，直接写会偏移叠加两次。
  找不到卡片则整体隐藏（fail-closed）。
- **踩过的坑**（都写进注释了）：
  - **已删除的「镶边」**：曾用"放大盒子 + `mask-composite` 只留边线"做 1.5px 绕行亮边，
    深色下会变成**一圈巨大的旋转发光矩形**（用户点名要求删掉）。教训：`mask-composite`
    必须 `-webkit-` 前缀与标准属性**双写**，且**绝不要放大盒子**；要做镶边应让盒子就是玻璃本身。
  - 玻璃里的彩色无论多淡都会显土；低饱和色块压在深底上还会变泥浆色。
  - 循环动画必须让元素在关键帧里**自己收束**——曾做成"无限上浮"，到顶被裁掉，看不出破灭。
  - 给会动的元素做 `scaleY` 调幅度时**必须显式写 `transform-origin`**，否则元素会"消失"。
  - 读 `getComputedStyle` / 条件调用 hook 都会在真实环境里炸；前者要 try/catch，后者要定序。
- **参考**：
  [wxperia/liquid-glass-vue](https://github.com/wxperia/liquid-glass-vue) 与
  [rdev/liquid-glass-react](https://github.com/rdev/liquid-glass-react)（折射位移图的算法来源），
  以及 Apple 的液态玻璃设计语言。

## 截图说明

`docs/light.png` 与 `docs/dark.png` 是设计稿（单文件 HTML 演示）在浏览器里的实拍；
插件的实现与设计稿逐像素对齐（同一套 CSS）。设计稿与全部探索过程在同一作者的
`magic-cast` 工作目录里，未随包发布。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> remove analog-liquid-glass-for-dsh
```

卸载后输入框恢复原样，不会残留样式（样式表随插件生命周期移除）。

## 许可证

plugins.description: Session deletion for DeepSeek Harness: recoverable trash-based delete, a sidebar menu row, and session_delete / session_restore agent tools.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-delete

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

[![test](https://github.com/hakulat2023/dsh-session-delete/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/hakulat2023/dsh-session-delete/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0b7285)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

Session **deletion** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

DeepSeek Harness can archive a Session, but archiving only hides it — there is no way to get rid of
one. This plugin adds that missing verb: **Delete session** in the Session row's “…” menu, a
`remote.sessionDelete` host namespace, and the `session_delete` / `session_restore` agent tools.

Deletion is deliberately **recoverable**: the Session's durable log is moved into a local trash
directory, so a mistake costs a `mv`, not a conversation.

- [What it does](#what-it-does)
- [Requirements](#requirements)
- [Install](#install)
- [Use](#use)
- [Configuration](#configuration)
- [Semantics and limits](#semantics-and-limits)
- [Development](#development)
- [Verified behaviour](#verified-behaviour)
- [License](#license)

## What it does

One deletion performs four steps:

1. **Admission.** The Session is asked the same questions archiving asks, through the
   `workspace/session-activity` waterfall. Live work is refused unless the caller allows a stop;
   when it is, `workspace/session-stop` cancels the turn and the plugin waits (bounded) for the
   Session to go idle. A Session still resident in the host process is refused *before any side
   effect* and only deleted after a second, explicit confirmation.
2. **Trash the log.** The Session's own directory is handed to the **platform's own trash** — the
   Finder's Trash on macOS, the XDG trash on Linux, the Recycle Bin on Windows — as
   `<sessionId>-<timestamp>`, carrying a `trash.json` record with the title, `cwd`, original
   directory, byte/file counts, and deletion time. `purge: true` deletes it outright instead.
   A small record is also written under `$DSH_HOME/session-delete/entries/` (entry path plus original
   directory, **no Session content**), because macOS refuses to let a process *enumerate* `~/.Trash`
   (TCC): without it a trashed Session could not be found again. See
   [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md).
3. **Drop the registrations.** The Session is detached from every Workspace account
   (`sessionIds`), removed from the registry-global archive and pin sets, and its projection-cache
   record is deleted.
4. **Tell the UI.** `api-session/removed` is emitted, so every connected browser drops the row
   immediately.

The Session directory is located through the persistence backend's own `locate(header)` when it
offers one, so a backend that changes its on-disk layout does not need a plugin update; otherwise the
plugin falls back to the documented `sessions/<projectKey(cwd)>/<encodeSegment(id)>` layout.

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.x` (developed and verified against `0.2.0-rc.2`) |
| Node.js | `>= 20` |
| Surface | any profile that mounts the Session store, the JSONL persistence backend, the Workspace registry, and the Web client (`dsh-web-app` / desktop) |

The plugin has **no npm dependencies** and **no build step**: the browser half is a hand-written
module in the `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` shape the Web client already consumes,
and the host half imports nothing outside `node:*`. See
[docs/plugin-packaging.md](docs/plugin-packaging.md) for why that matters for third-party plugins.

## Install

The package is a DSH **bundle**: `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and `dsh.client`, and
`cordis.patch.yml` inserts the host row.

```bash
# from a local checkout (this repository)
plugin_manager install_bundle   target: /absolute/path/to/dsh-session-delete

# or from GitHub, by tag, with the bundled CLI
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:hakulat2023/dsh-session-delete#v0.1.0

# or from the registry, once published
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-session-delete
```

The bundle patch that gets mounted is one row:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: session-delete
      name: dsh-session-delete
```

After installing, **restart the application once**. The host half is a Node ESM module and the
running process keeps the module generation it already loaded (DSH's own limitation: a replaced
package needs a restart to load fresh JavaScript). The browser half is served from disk and only
needs a page reload.

## Use

### Web UI

Session row → **“…”** → **Delete session** → confirm.

- A **running** Session is stopped first: the first confirmation already carries that intent.
- A Session that is still **resident** in the host (typically the one you have open) is described as
  such and needs a second confirmation; the first click has no side effect at all.
- On success the row disappears everywhere and a toast reports the outcome **and the trash directory**
  (a Session whose log was already gone is reported as such, never as a move).

### Agent tools

| Tool | Arguments | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `session_delete` | `session_id` (required), `stop_activity` (default `true`), `force` (default `false`), `purge` (default `false`) | Moves the Session to the trash; `purge: true` deletes the bytes permanently instead. |
| `session_restore` | `session_id` (required) | Moves a trashed Session directory back to its original location. |

### Remote namespace

`remote.sessionDelete.delete({ sessionId, stopActivity?, force?, purge? })` and
`remote.sessionDelete.restore({ sessionId })` — the same operations the UI dialog uses.

### Restoring by hand

A trashed Session is an ordinary directory in the platform's trash:

| Platform | Where it went | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| macOS | `~/.Trash/<sessionId>-<timestamp>/` | Finder shows it; “Put Back” is not offered (Finder did not move it), but `session_restore` works |
| Linux | `$XDG_DATA_HOME/Trash/files/…` with its `.trashinfo` | the desktop's own “Restore” works as well |
| Windows | the Recycle Bin | the plugin cannot read the bin back, so restore it by hand |

```bash
cat ~/.Trash/<sessionId>-*/trash.json      # originalDirectory, title, cwd, sizes
```

`session_restore(session_id)` puts it back and withdraws both records; the Session reappears in the
list once the Workspace registry next indexes stored headers (a reload, or the next launch).

## Configuration

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `trash` | `"system"` | Destination: `"system"` uses the platform's own trash, `"directory"` uses `trashRoot`, and any other string is taken as an absolute directory. |
| `trashRoot` | `$DSH_HOME/session-trash` | The directory used by `trash: directory` (and by `trashRoot` alone, for 0.1 compatibility). |
| `restoreIndexRoot` | `$DSH_HOME/session-delete` | Where the restore records live (`entries/<entry name>.json`). Metadata only — never Session content. |

```yaml
# keep the platform trash (the default): nothing to configure
- id: session-delete
  name: dsh-session-delete

# or own the destination, e.g. on a machine whose ~/.Trash is undesirable
- id: session-delete
  name: dsh-session-delete
  config:
    trash: directory
    trashRoot: /Volumes/big/dsh-session-trash
```

## Semantics and limits

- **Your trash, your decision.** Deleted Sessions land in the platform's trash and stay there until
  *you* empty it; the plugin never empties it, and it leaves no trash directory of its own behind.
- **macOS will not let a process list `~/.Trash`.** Moving in, reading a known entry, and moving it
  back out all work; `readdir` is refused by TCC. That is the only reason a restore record exists —
  `session_restore` follows the record instead of searching the trash. Emptying the trash makes the
  record stale, and a stale record is pruned rather than reported as a failure.
- **Windows restore is manual.** The Recycle Bin has no consumer-facing API for finding an entry
  again, so `session_delete` reports `trashedTo: null` and `session_restore` explains that the folder
  has to be restored f

plugins.description: General Agentics distribution bundle for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): one install brings white-label brand, curated plugins, bundled skills, and MCP pre-configuration. Built on DeepSeek Harness (DSH), MIT licensed.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-general-agentics

**General Agentics 發行套件（bundle）for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)。**

用戶先安裝 DSH，再安裝本套件，一次獲得：

1. **貼牌**：側邊欄 mark/wordmark、對話首頁 hero 文字 logo、品牌主色、分頁標題、favicon（皆為執行期替換，不修改、不破壞已安裝的 DSH）
2. **自帶技能**：`ga-identity`（教導 agent 以 General Agentics 身分自介與簽署產出）
3. **MCP 預配置**：策劃中的 MCP 伺服器清單（見 `mcp/`）
4. **精選第三方插件**：機制保留（依賴＋顯式 insert row 隨套件啟用）；目前策劃清單為空，profile 端另行精選安裝

Built on DeepSeek Harness (DSH), MIT licensed.

## 設計原則

- **只走官方縫隙**：品牌透過三個 generic brand slot 佔位（`priority: -1` 陰影覆蓋官方 occupants——slot 規則是「同 cell 最低 priority 者渲染」），不停用 `ui-brand-official`，不修改任何 DSH 檔案。
- **不破簽章、不怕升級**：本套件存在於 profile（`~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/node_modules`），DSH 升級不會覆蓋它；解除安裝即完全還原官方品牌。
- **手寫、零建置**：`lib/client.js` 採用 shell module loader 的 lazy-CJS 形狀（與 dsh-pomodoro 等第三方出貨格式一致），無需 repo 內未發佈的 build preset。

## 覆蓋範圍（誠實清單）

| 表面 | 本套件 | 備註 |
|---|---|---|
| 側邊欄 mark / wordmark | ✅ | slot 佔位；2026-10-13 瀏覽器實測（乾淨 profile）確認渲染 |
| 對話首頁 hero mark | ✅ | slot 佔位；實測確認我們的 wordmark 渲染 |
| 品牌主色 | ✅ | `theme.overrideTokens`（light/dark 成對，契約要求）。注意 token 寫在 `<body>` 的 inline style 上，不是 `:root`；量測時別探 `document.documentElement` |
| 分頁標題 | ✅ | 執行期改寫 + MutationObserver 抵抗 shell 重設；實測 `document.title === "General Agentics"` |
| favicon | ✅ | 執行期替換 `link[rel=icon]`；實測兩個 link 皆為 data URI 且含品牌色 |
| PWA 名稱 | ⚠️ 盡力 | manifest link 換 data URI，瀏覽器是否採納視實作 |
| 首跑 Preview Notice 彈窗 | ❌ 未覆蓋 | client 樹內字串，一次點名 DeepSeek Harness 三次，是客戶第一眼看到的畫面。2026-10-13 瀏覽器實測發現；client.js 修得到（尚未修） |
| Hero tagline「Into the Unknown」 | ❌ 未覆蓋 | 與我們的 hero wordmark 並排顯示；同為 client 樹內字串，尚未修 |
| 桌面殼（Dock icon／選單／About） | ❌ | 在簽章保護的 app.asar 內，本套件不碰 |
| host 端字串（system prompt、User-Agent） | ❌ | 硬編碼；以 `ga-identity` skill 於任務層補償 |

## 安裝

```sh
# 方式一：GUI（App 運行中）——側欄 Plugins → Add plugin → 貼包名或本機路徑
dsh-general-agentics            # npm 包名（發佈後）
/path/to/dsh-general-agentics   # 本機 clone 的絕對路徑

# 方式二：模型側工具（App 運行中）——對話中請 agent 執行
#   plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "dsh-general-agentics" }

# 方式三：CLI（desktop profile 須先完全退出桌面 App）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-general-agentics
```

安裝後：
- **網頁重新整理一次**（Cmd+R）即可載入品牌 client half（側邊欄 mark/wordmark、hero 文字 logo 與致敬行、主色、分頁標題、favicon、輸入框下方的 START HERE 模塊）
- **新建的 session** 會獲得 `ga-identity` 等 14 個技能與 `mcp__ga-status__ga_bundle_info` 工具（MCP 伺服器於組合套用時即由 host spawn）
- 完全重啟 App 亦無妨

**解除安裝／停用**：
```sh
# 停用（保留檔案）：GUI Plugins 頁關閉 bundle，或在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 寫：
#   - id: general-agentics
#     disabled: true
# 解除安裝：GUI Plugins → Remove，或退出 App 後 CLI：
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-general-agentics
```

**開發迭代**：以 `link:` 指向本機 clone 安裝——改 `lib/client.js` 後重新整理頁面即生效；
改 `cordis.patch.yml` 或 `lib/index.js`（host 半）則套用新組合（HMR live）。
內容變更後重新以 `file:` 安裝時記得升版號——pnpm 對同版號的 `file:` 包可能不重新解包。
離線驗證組合用拋棄式 profile：見 `docs/ops-lessons.md` rule 13。

**發布前注意**：
- LICENSE 已在 repo 根目錄（npm 自動收入 tarball）
- MCP row 已是可攜形式（`process.execPath` + `baseUrl`，見 `cordis.patch.yml`；實測紀錄在 `docs/ops-lessons.md` rule 14）
- 對外表述維持 "Built on DeepSeek Harness (DSH), MIT licensed"

## 套件結構

```
dsh-general-agentics/
├── package.json        # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client 宣告＋精選插件 dependencies
├── cordis.patch.yml    # 本套件 Loader row＋MCP row＋精選插件 insert rows
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js        # host half：技能 provider（掃 skills/ 註冊）
│   └── client.js       # browser half：品牌 slot、主題、標題/favicon、START HERE
├── brand/
│   ├── mark.svg        # 佔位 mark 設計檔（client.js 內有對應 inline 版本）
│   └── wordmark.svg    # 佔位 wordmark 設計檔
├── skills/
│   ├── ga-identity/    # 自帶技能：General Agentics 身分與簽署
│   ├── (13 個方法論技能)  # vendored from obra/superpowers @ bb92a77（MIT，逐字未改）
│   ├── superpowers/    # 上游 LICENSE + UPSTREAM-SHA（無 SKILL.md，不註冊）
│   └── THIRD-PARTY.md  # 署名與更新指引
├── mcp/
│   └── ga-status-server.mjs  # ga_bundle_info 狀態回報（零依賴 stdio MCP server）
└── test/
    └── skill-provider.test.mjs  # node --test，零依賴
```

## 換正式品牌素材

| 要換什麼 | 改哪裡 |
|---|---|
| 產品名稱 | `lib/client.js` 的 `PRODUCT_NAME` / `PRODUCT_SHORT_NAME` |
| mark 圖形 | `lib/client.js` 的 `GAMark`（paths）＋ `brand/mark.svg` |
| wordmark | `lib/client.js` 的 `GAName` |
| 品牌色 | `lib/client.js` 的 `BRAND_COLOR` / `FAVICON_COLOR`（light/dark 成對） |
| favicon | `lib/client.js` 的 `faviconHref()` |

## 隨附技能（bundled skills）

14 個技能隨包註冊（`ctx.skills.registerProvider`，bundled rank 600——用戶自帶同名技能一律優先）：

- `ga-identity`：以 General Agentics 身分自介與簽署產出
- 13 個方法論技能 vendored 自 [obra/superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers)（MIT，逐字未改）：
  `brainstorming`、`writing-plans`、`executing-plans`、`test-driven-development`、`systematic-debugging`、`verification-before-completion`、`writing-skills`、`diagnosing-superpowers`、`subagent-driven-development`、`dispatching-parallel-agents`、`requesting-code-review`、`receiving-code-review`、`finishing-a-development-branch`
  ——15 個上游技能取 13；`using-superpowers`（其「任何回應前必查技能」規則與 `ga-identity` 的身分主導權衝突）與 `using-git-worktrees`（團隊 git 工作流）刻意不入，理由見 `skills/THIRD-PARTY.md`。

**感謝**：Jesse Vincent (obra) 與 superpowers 貢獻者；詳見 `skills/THIRD-PARTY.md`。

## 合規備忘

- 本套件 MIT；散布時保留 DSH 的 MIT 與 `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`（DSH 端授權義務）。
- 對外表述使用 "Built on DeepSeek Harness (DSH)"；不以 DeepSeek Harness 作為產品名，不使用官方 logo。
- `ga-identity` skill 內含給 agent 的對外表述規則。

plugins.description: 本地一个窗口，驱动你所有机器上的 dsh · Drive the dsh instances on your other machines from one local window
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-control

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

**Every machine already runs dsh. Make this one window the front end for all of them.**

Chat with the dsh instances on your other machines, natively from your local sidebar.
Remote sessions stream back token by token; the remote uses its own model credentials,
tools and sandbox. Zero changes on the remote. Zero dependencies. One-line install.

![dsh-control in action](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/6mt/dsh-control/main/docs/hero.png)

*A real two-machine setup. **Left**: the remote machine's own dsh — the session there was created
for you and auto-named `控制端·<local title>` (①). **Right**: your local dsh — the same question
runs on the remote (③ the model route is the environment name, `cn-dsh2`) and the answer lands in a
local session inside the workspace the plugin created for that environment (②).*

> 🎬 A 15-second capture (one-click connect → streaming reply) is being recorded.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-control
```

After installing, **fully quit and reopen dsh** (⌘Q). A「远程 dsh 环境」panel appears
in the right sidebar.

## How is this different from dsh-remote / dsh-remote-ssh?

![How the two approaches differ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/6mt/dsh-control/main/docs/compare.svg)

| | Remote-workspace plugins (dsh-remote, …) | **dsh-control** |
|---|---|---|
| The remote machine is a | **file system** (SFTP tool set) | **dsh that is already running there** |
| Sessions live | local session + remote directory | **remote sessions, native in your sidebar** |
| Credentials & tools | configured locally, SSH config duplicated | the remote's own — nothing copied |
| Remote needs | only SSH | dsh installed (≥0.2.0-rc.2) with its web instance running |
| Changes on the remote | some deploy dsh for you | **zero** (read-only probing + the remote's own API) |

The two **coexist** (tested side by side): no dsh on the remote → use dsh-remote;
dsh already there → use dsh-control.

## What it does

![The remote dsh environments panel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/6mt/dsh-control/main/docs/panel.png)

*The「远程 dsh 环境」panel: type `user@host` and connect — the row then reports its state and
whether the environment already has its workspace.*

- **One-click connect** — type `user@host`; the plugin probes the remote dsh, fetches
  its access token and opens an encrypted channel (~5 s)
- **Automatic workspace** — each environment gets a same-named local workspace; any
  session created inside it automatically becomes a remote session
- **True streaming** — remote replies flow in token by token, not dumped at the end
- **Paired naming** — remote sessions are named `控制端·<local title>`, so both sides match
- **Visible & self-healing** — remote sessions are marked in the sidebar; disconnects
  are reported honestly and repaired by one click

## Security

**What it does on your machine**: one state file
(`$DSH_HOME/dsh-control/state.json`, mode 0600, holds the remote access tokens) and an
on-demand SSH tunnel process.
**What it never does**: no installs or writes on the remote, no lifecycle management of
the remote dsh, never reads your other local credentials, tokens never enter logs.
When passwordless SSH is not set up it shows the exact one-line fix — passwords are
never stored. Details in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Known limitations

- The remote must already run dsh with its web instance (otherwise use a
  remote-workspace plugin)
- Connects over SSH (passwordless or configured key; a direct no-SSH mode is on the roadmap)
- Sidebar markers and the streaming feel are verified by eye per release
- Cancelling a remote turn is implemented but marked experimental

## Development

```sh
node --check lib/*.js
for t in test/*.test.mjs; do node "$t"; done   # 52 checks: unit / contract / structural invariants
scripts/verify-boot-selfheal.sh                # boot self-heal (needs a local dsh runtime)
```

## License

MIT © 6mt

plugins.description: AI 输出信任边界：检查代码有没有直接执行 AI 输出（eval/shell/SQL/路径）。
plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-ai-output-trust

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust)


**关键词**：AI 输出 · AI 安全 · 提示注入 · 提示词注入 · 大模型安全 · 任意代码执行 · LLM 安全 · 大模型
**Keywords**: AI output trust · prompt injection · LLM security · code execution · OWASP LLM
**AI 输出信任边界** —— 检查代码有没有直接执行 AI 输出。

## 不装它会怎样

你的 agent 里有这么一行：

```js
eval(aiResponse);
```

想法是「让模型生成一小段脚本，我执行它」。

**但 AI 输出是不可信输入** —— 它可能被提示注入控制，也可能自己发挥。
你等于把**任意代码执行权交给了一个概率模型**。

OWASP 把这单列为 **LLM05 Improper Output Handling**。

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 🔴 严重 | `eval(aiResponse)` / `new Function(...)` |
| 🔴 严重 | AI 输出拼进 `exec` / `spawn` |
| 🟠 高 | AI 输出拼进 SQL |
| 🟠 高 | 文件路径来自 AI 输出（路径穿越）|

## 它不会误报「只是调了模型」

变量识别用**精确命名**，不是「看到 `.content` 就报」。

**这段不报**（调了模型，但当成不可信输入处理）：
```js
const raw = result.choices[0].message.content;
const parsed = safeJsonParse(raw);
if (!schema.validate(parsed)) throw new Error('invalid');
```

**这段报**：
```js
eval(aiResponse);
```

## 正确的做法

```
AI 输出 → 结构化解析 → Schema 校验 → 白名单分支
        → 参数化查询
        → 路径规范化 + 断言在允许根目录内
```

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-ai-output-trust
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-ai-output-trust
```

## 用法

```bash
dsh-ai-output-trust --demo          # 看检出效果
dsh-ai-output-trust --list-rules    # 列出规则和依据
dsh-ai-output-trust --html r.html
```

![dsh-ai-output-trust 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-ai-output-trust/report.png)

![dsh-ai-output-trust 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-ai-output-trust/demo.png)

![dsh-ai-output-trust 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-ai-output-trust/rules.png)

## 边界

- **只查四种明确的高危用法**（eval / shell / SQL / 路径）。其它「间接信任」不在范围。
- **靠变量命名识别** —— 建议统一命名（`ai*` / `llm*` / `model*`），否则会漏。
- **不做数据流分析**，只看调用点附近。
- 与 [dsh-ci-guard](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ci-guard) 分工：那个查 GitHub Actions 脚本注入，这个查运行时。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**


---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 22 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export)

**AI 与 Agent 治理** ｜ [**AI 输出信任**](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope)

**数据与凭据** ｜ [敏感数据](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) · [密钥轮换](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate)

**供应链与构建** ｜ [开源许可](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-license-guard) · [依赖投毒](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-dep-audit) · [CI 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ci-guard)

**权限与应急** ｜ [最小权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege) · [告警外发](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-alert-relay) · [应急证据包](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-incident-package)

都在 DSH 插件市场（dsh-plugin.org）和 npm 上，`dsh plugin --profile web add <包名>` 即可安装。

## License

plugins.readme_text:
# DeepWork

> An enterprise agent has to know what a project is, who owns it, which customer it belongs
> to, and **what it is allowed to touch**. DeepWork is where an enterprise writes that down —
> and where an agent's tools and permissions are derived from it, and enforced.
>
> It is deliberately not part of an agent. The world it describes belongs to the enterprise, so
> the second agent, the third, and the one after that read the same one.

DeepWork is a platform built on [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
(DSH). DSH ships a complete agent harness; DeepWork adds the one thing it does not ship — the
enterprise's own world, and the rules for acting in it. A plugin, not a fork, and a new domain
costs YAML rather than code.

## The whole project, as one line

Every part of this repository is one step of the same journey: a **world is declared**, an
**agent is equipped** from it, and what that agent does is **governed** on the way out.

```
   the enterprise's world                       what the agent gets
   ──────────────────────                       ────────────────────
①  declared    objects, relations, states,  →   a domain is data: `schema.yaml` and the
               who may write what                instances beside it

②  derived     read tools, the write tool,  →   a capability is declared, not coded —
               declared actions and queries      nothing in TypeScript to add or remove

③  authorised  `written_by` per type,       →   the host's own file and shell tools are
               roles per deployment              covered too; no roles means read-only

④  gated       states, the moves between    →   a move needing a second pair of eyes is
               them, and what each needs         refused without a verdict from somebody
                                                 other than the person making the move

⑤  recorded    the audit trail and write    →   every attempt, refusals included; field
               provenance                        names and never field values

⑥  checked     `npm run validate`           →   a declaration that did not take effect is
                                                 a failure, not a silence
```

Read it top to bottom and this repository is one thing. Read the sections below out of order
and it is a list of mechanisms.

The same line as a picture:

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  subgraph assembly["assembly"]
    prof["a profile: which plugins, which roles, which domain, which mode — changing the deployment changes only this layer"]
  end

  subgraph data["a domain — data, not code"]
    schema["schema.yaml — objects · relations · functions · states and transitions · who may write · actions · queries · situation · skill"]
    inst["the instances beside it"]
  end

  subgraph dw["DeepWork — a plugin, not a fork"]
    eng["the engine — reads the domain, builds the graph, derives the edges"]
    der["derivation — the read tools and query modes, the write tool, declared actions, the lifecycle's requirements"]
    gov["governance — the guard mounted globally in front of every call, permissions derived from written_by, review checked against provenance, an audit of field names and never field values"]
    inj["injection — the rules the situation marks, in the prompt and in the catalogue"]
    cap["a capability — a second plugin, declaring what its tools touch"]
  end

  subgraph hosted["the host — DeepSeek Harness"]
    loop["the agent loop · the tool registry · the skill and prompt registries · the session"]
    own["its own file and shell tools"]
  end

  prof --> dw
  schema --> eng
  inst --> eng
  eng --> der
  eng --> gov
  eng --> inj
  der -->|"the tool surface an agent is given"| loop
  inj -->|"the rules block, and the catalogue"| loop
  gov -->|"judges each call before it runs"| loop
  cap -->|"declares, so it is judged too"| gov
  gov -->|"or the host's own tools are the way around it"| own
  loop -->|"a write that was allowed"| wrote["the instance file, and one structured audit entry"]
  gov --> refused["a refusal, and one structured audit entry naming the rule that refused"]
```

Two places in that picture answer questions people expect one place to answer, so they are worth
naming. The guard is the door: before any tool runs, may this call touch this path at all. The write
path is the desk: may this content be written, by this caller, in this state. A capability's own
tools stop at the door; this plugin's write tool passes the door unjudged and is settled at the desk,
because nothing declares `ontology_write` and it is not in the built-in table — so its authority
lives inside the tool rather than in the mounted guard.

[docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) is the same route written out — the layers, one write end to end, and the limits named; and the [same document in Chinese](docs/architecture.zh.md) is there for a reader who works in Chinese.

## Who this is for

Anyone putting an agent into a real business system. A forward-deployed engineer standing up
the first use case; a platform team that has to answer "what is this agent allowed to touch,
and who approved it"; the team that inherits it six months later.

## If you only look at one thing

`packages/ontology/examples/engagement` is the whole line at small scale: four stages, three of
them gated on a signature scoped to that stage, one declared action, one relation.

```sh
corepack pnpm install            # once, right after cloning — nothing else is needed
npm run validate                  # is it sound? exit 0 or a list of what did not take effect
node packages/ontology/scripts/show-derivation.ts packages/ontology/examples/engagement
```

The second command prints what came out of the declaration — and note what it prints with no
roles configured: three read tools, no write tool, and no actions derived, because an
unconfigured deployment is a read-only one.

Then `packages/ontology/src/examples.test.ts` runs it for real — a stage cannot be entered
without its signature, a signature for one stage does not open the next, and the role that
makes a move cannot sign for it. Those three sentences are the project, and they are a test
rather than a paragraph.

## The gap this fills

DSH ships a complete agent harness — loop, tools, skills, workflows, plan mode, approval,
subagents, sandboxing. What it does not ship is any notion of *the enterprise world* the
agent is working in. A general agent sees `document_001`, `project_782`, `user_23891`. An
enterprise agent needs to know what a project is, who owns it, which customer it belongs
to, and what it is allowed to touch.

That gap is semantic, not mechanical. This project fills it, and nothing else.

There is a third layer between the model and the harness, and this project is it. A model
reasons; a harness executes; neither knows what the enterprise *is*. That layer has to be
**declared**, and that word is doing the work. A context assembled per request out of whatever a
search surfaced is a guess about relevance — a good guess, and still a guess, and different on
Tuesday. A context declared as objects, relations and rules is a fact the enterprise can be asked
about, diffed, and held to, and the same question asked twice answers the same way.

It also has to distinguish what somebody vouched for from what merely got recorded. A layer that
cannot tell a rule a person signed off on from a note an agent wrote yesterday has made its own
trustworthiness a second thing nobody can check — so that distinction is a lifecycle here, and
only the vouched-for half ever reaches an agent.

```
DSH provides                    DeepWork adds
──────────────                  ──────────────
agent loop                      ontology    entities, relations, declared queries
tools                           governance  written_by, file_location, required_fields
skills                          injection   the vouched-for rules, marked for the situation in hand
                                audit       every write attempt, refusals included
workflow
plan mode
human review
sandbox
```

## The claim

**A domain author writes YAML. The agent gets tools. No
